title: Nebraska Football Losses: Embarrassing Mistakes or Dumb (Un)Luck?
text:
This is a story about Nebraska Football. Today we are going to explore the losses the team (and the fans) have suffered and breaking down the reasons behind them.


Code
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
logs24 <- read_csv("footballlogs24.csv")
logs26 <- read_csv("nebfootball26new.csv")


More of the story here we go


Code
winlosslogs <- logs24 |>
  mutate(
    wins = case_when(
      grepl("W", Result) ~ 1,
      grepl("L", Result) ~ 0
    )
  )

yardsper <- winlosslogs |>
  group_by(Team, Conference) |>
  summarise(
    total_plays = sum(OffensivePlays),
    total_yards = sum(OffensiveYards),
    defensive_plays = sum(DefPlays),
    defensive_yards = sum(DefYards),
    total_wins = sum(wins)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    offensive_ypp = total_yards / total_plays,
    defensive_ypp = defensive_yards / defensive_plays
  )

nu <- yardsper |>
  filter(Team == "Nebraska")

yardsper |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarise(
    offense= mean(offensive_ypp),
    defense = mean(defensive_ypp)
  )


# A tibble: 1 × 2
  offense defense
    <dbl>   <dbl>
1    5.76    5.60


Code
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = yardsper,
    aes(x = offensive_ypp, y = defensive_ypp, size = total_wins),
    alpha = .3
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(3, 8), name = "Wins") +
  geom_point(
    data = nu,
    aes(
      x = offensive_ypp,
      y = defensive_ypp,
      size = total_wins
    ),
    color = "red"
  )+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5.763149) +
  geom_hline(yintercept= 5.601157)











Code
bigten <- logs24 |> filter(Conference == "Big Ten Conference")|>
  mutate(
    total_plays = PassingAtt + RushingAtt,
    total_yards = PassingYds + RushingYds,
    offensive_ypp = total_yards / total_plays,
  )

bigten |> summarise(
    avg_ypp = mean(OffenseAvg)
  )
